P3In the shop today · the recorded value movesA reading on a work order is recorded when the work order is invoiced, or when a service is marked complete on it. It counts only if someone entered or changed the value on that work order; the mileage a new work order copies from the asset is not a reading.
BEFORE
MileageThe estimate carries the last recorded reading forward at a measured rate.
Last recordedRecorded
342,417Recorded 29 Aug 2026 · WO S3780-15211
Current estimate346,050Measured from 4 visits · 640 a week
High
AFTER
MileageA recorded reading replaces the estimate outright. There is nothing left to project until the next visit.
Last recordedIn the shop
346,900Entered today on WO S3780-15904 · fixed on invoice
When a work order reading countsA work order reading is recorded when the work order is invoiced, or when a service is marked complete on that work order, and only if someone entered or changed the value. The mileage a new work order copies from the asset is not a reading.
The estimate is replaced, not averagedA recorded reading supersedes whatever was projected. The rate is then worked out again from the last three usable pairs of readings, read as one period, and the last reading is carried forward at that rate. At least two readings are needed for any estimate.
In the shop is not yet recordedA unit on an open work order shows the value the advisor typed, dated today. The invoice is what fixes it.
Everything dependent moves at onceDue points, statuses and the worklist re-resolve on the save, not overnight. The one moment the truck is physically present is now.

The date sits on top, everywhereRoutine and compliance rows read the same way: the date first, its rule underneath. The column is called Comes due, so the date is what answers it.
Every candidate is shownA service with three triggers has three candidate dates. Showing one and hiding two is what made the old cell unreadable.
The earliest is marked, not just sortedFirst says which trigger the system expects to fire. Sorting alone leaves the reader to work it out.
A compliance term is always knownThere is no state where a compliance service has no term, so the cell always resolves. A missing certificate is noted on the row, not in this cell.
